mapper.select: SELECT p.*, pc.parent_id cateParentId, s.id sku_id,s.product_id sku_product_id,s.price sku_price,s.promotion_price sku_promotion_price, s.low_stock sku_low_stock,s.pic sku_pic,s.sale sku_sale,s.sku_code sku_sku_code, s.stock sku_stock,s.lock_stock sku_lock_stock,s.sp_data sku_sp_data, a.id attribute_id,a.product_id attribute_product_id,a.product_attribute_id attribute_product_attribute_id,a.value attribute_value FROM pms_product p LEFT JOIN pms_product_category pc on pc.id = p.product_category_id LEFT JOIN pms_sku_stock s ON s.product_id = p.id LEFT JOIN pms_product_attribute_value a ON a.product_id = p.id WHERE p.id = #{id}
